meta.title: Packages & pricing
meta.description: Solar packages with all-in starting prices, add-ons and flexible ways to pay: cash, card installment or a bank loan.

hero.heading: Clear prices. ^No surprises.^
hero.lead: Pick a standard system to start from, add what you need, then choose how you want to pay.

packages.heading: Pick a package
packages.lead: All-in starting prices for our standard systems. Your final quote follows a free site survey.
packages.note: Starting price for the standard package. The final price depends on the brands you choose, your roof, add-ons and the site survey. Use the calculator for an estimate based on your bill.

addOns.heading: Add to your system
addOns.lead: Extras you can include now or add later.

payments.heading: Flexible payment options
payments.lead: Solar pays for itself. Choose the plan that fits your budget.
payments.tip: The calculator shows your estimated monthly savings, so you can compare them with a monthly payment.
payments.disclaimer: Monthly amounts are estimates only. Final terms and rates depend on the lender's approval.
